rail.unreadAria: Unread mentions or replies on this relay

addModal.title: Add a relay
addModal.subtitle: Pick a popular relay or enter a custom URL to connect.
addModal.urlHint: Paste a NIP-29 group relay URL. Each relay is a separate “server” in the rail.

rail.confirmRemoveBody: You can add it back later.

empty.title: Pick a channel or DM
empty.description: Choose from the sidebar, or hit + to create a new channel.

channel.noMessages: No messages yet. Be the first.
channel.notVisible: Channel not visible on this relay
channel.notVisibleDescription: The link points to {id}, but this relay isn't exposing it to you. You may need to be added as a member, or switch to the relay that hosts it.
channel.forumHint: A feed of publications, each with its own chat
channel.voiceHelp: Adds a <tag></tag> tag. Members open <url></url> to join.
channel.sfuHelp: Adds a <tag></tag> tag. Same join surface as voice, but the channel signals to operators “expect a big room”. An authorized SFU joins and forwards everyone’s media so the room scales past the 4-peer mesh ceiling.
channel.forumHelp: Adds a <tag></tag> tag (the wire value keeps its original name). The channel renders as a feed of publications instead of a chat stream: each publication is its own channel, with its own conversation.
channel.forumTagsHint: Curated; published as NIP-29 tag metadata
channel.forumTagsHelp: Pick a small set of categories so members can browse publications by topic. Authors pick from this list: they can't invent new tags. Each tag gets its own color automatically; set one explicitly if you want a specific hue. Emoji is optional but helps the chip row scan at a glance.

invite.copiedTitle: Link copied. Only members of this relay can open it

message.confirmDeleteEveryoneBody: It will be removed from the channel for everyone.
message.confirmDeleteOwnBody: It will be removed from the channel.

inbox.markReadDmsTitle: Mark all direct messages as read
inbox.markReadMentionsTitle: Mark all mentions on this relay as read

channels.empty: No channels on this relay yet.
channels.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
channels.mentions: {count, plural, one {# mention or reply} other {# mentions or replies}}

server.settingsHelp: Available only to the relay operator.

roles.title: Roles & ranks
roles.description: Tiered badges shown next to member names.

members.title: Members & moderation
members.description: Review, demote, and kick across channels.

layout.empty: No categories yet. Add one above to start organizing.
layout.allPlaced: All channels are placed in categories.
layout.saveHelp: Saved as a single replaceable kind 30078 event signed by you.

members.demoteHelp: Strip admin role; keep them in the channel as a regular member.
members.emptyPublic: No members yet. Not required: the relay whitelist controls access.
members.emptyPrivate: No members yet. Add at least one to grant access.

tags.name: Tag name
tags.empty: No tags yet. Add one to give publication authors something to pick.

sfu.help: Enter one SFU URL. Obelisk verifies its <info></info> descriptor and stores the returned identity automatically. Calls authenticate directly to the SFU; Nostr relays are only a compatibility fallback.
sfu.verifyHelp: The SFU checks your signed Nostr identity and whitelist when you join. The full pubkey above is available for advanced verification.
sfu.capacity: up to {count, plural, one {# participant} other {# participants}}

has.title: Includes a specific type of data

date.title: Sent before or after a date

search.messagesPrompt: Type to search messages. Try filters (from:, in:, mentions:, has:, before:, after:).
search.unresolved: Couldn't resolve {token}: no matching user or channel.
search.noNip50: This relay doesn't support server-side search, so only recent messages were scanned.
search.localFilterNote: Some terms were matched on this device.

railRelay.title: Relays are communities
railRelay.body: Each one holds its own channels, members and history. You don't have an account on it. Your key is the same everywhere.

railAdd.title: Add another
railAdd.body: Paste any NIP-29 relay address to join its channels. Leaving is removing it from this list.

channels.title: Channels
channels.body: Text, voice and publications on this relay. What you read here comes from this relay only.

railFeed.title: The feed is all of Nostr
railFeed.body: Posts from the whole network over your own relays, not the relay you are chatting on.

railDm.title: Private messages
railDm.body: Encrypted end to end and delivered over the relay list you publish, not this one.

composer.title: Everything you send is signed
composer.body: Messages are events signed by your key, so other Nostr clients can read this channel too.

feedSource.title: Following or everyone
feedSource.body: Following is the people you follow; Global is whatever your feed relays are carrying right now.

feedSearch.title: Search the network
feedSearch.body: People, posts and #tags across Nostr (different from the search in a relay, which only covers its channels).

feedCompose.title: Post to Nostr
feedCompose.body: This goes to your feed relays and reaches every Nostr client, not just Obelisk.

dms.title: Only you two can read these
dms.body: Conversations are encrypted with your keys. Relays store them without being able to open them.

inbox.title: Mentions and messages
inbox.body: Mentions come from the relay you have open; direct messages follow you across all of them.

voice.title: Voice runs between you
voice.body: Calls are peer to peer where they can be, with the relay used only to introduce you.

identity.title: Your key is your account
identity.body: No email, no password, nothing to recover. Back up your nsec and you can sign in anywhere.

relayStatus.title: What is connected
relayStatus.body: Open it to see which relays are answering, how fast, and whether this one has let you in.

pastedKey.title: You pasted your private key
pastedKey.body: This is the least safe way to log in. A signer extension or a bunker keeps your key out of this page.

notRemembered.title: Logged in for this visit only
notRemembered.body: This browser can't keep your key safely, so you'll need to log in again next time.

notice.vaultUnavailable: This browser can't keep your key safely between visits, so you were logged out. A signer extension or a bunker keeps you signed in without storing a key here.
notice.unlockFailed: We couldn't unlock your saved key, so you were logged out. Log in again.

login.title: Connect to Nostr
login.subtitle: Choose your login method
login.npubHelp: Your npub is your public profile address. Share it so people can find and follow you. It is safe to share: your nsec is the key that stays private.

signer.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the URI below
signer.fallbackHint: Fallback: copy it, then in Amber open New application → Paste from clipboard.

login.keyLoginFailed: Could not log in with that key.
login.finishFailed: Could not finish setting up your account. Try again.

create.help: Channels are public and open by default: anyone the relay accepts can read and post. You can lock it down later in <settings></settings>.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: Cached channels and messages remain available. Reconnecting when your network returns.

authenticating.title: Authenticating with {host}…
authenticating.bunker: Approve the signing request in your bunker app.
authenticating.nip07: Approve the signing request in your Nostr extension.

authRequired.title: Not authenticated to {host}
authRequired.reapprove: NIP-42 AUTH did not complete. Reapprove the signing request.
authRequired.reload: NIP-42 AUTH did not complete. Try reloading.

restricted.title: Not whitelisted on {host}
restricted.body: Your pubkey is signed in, but this relay won’t serve or accept events. Ask the operator to add you, or switch relays.

unreachable.body: The relay isn’t responding. Retrying in the background.

error.title: Relay error on {host}
error.body: The relay rejected the request. Try reloading or switching relays.

modal.authBunker: Approve the signing request in your bunker app to complete NIP-42 AUTH.
modal.authNip07: Approve the signing request in your Nostr extension to complete NIP-42 AUTH.
modal.authFailed: NIP-42 AUTH did not complete. Try reloading or switching login methods.
modal.unreachable: The relay isn’t responding. It may be offline, blocked by your network, or briefly unavailable. We’ll keep trying in the background. Switch relays if you need to keep working.
modal.restricted: This relay accepted your signature but won’t serve or accept events from your pubkey. Ask the operator to add you to its allowlist, or switch relays.
